newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Corp approved as gas oil wholesaler.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Corp approved as gas oil wholesaler.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp said on Thursday it had been authorised by the Ministry of Home Affairs to become a gas-oil wholesaler.
The terms of the approval require the company to import at least 50,000 kilolitres of gas oil per year, a company spokesman said.
The firm intends to buy cargoes from South Korea and Singapore, he said.

Although Mitsubishi Corp has been active in arranging gas oil imports for domestic refiners, this will be the first time the trading house has imported gas oil under its own name, a Mitsubishi trader said.
Another trading house, Itochu Corp, was authorised to be a gas-oil wholesaler last year.
